name: Victoriana Vasquez — marriage in January 1875, Degollado, Jalisco, Mexico
researcher_question: When and where did Victoriana Vasquez, daughter of Remigio Vasquez and Bernarda Sandoval, marry Jose Cleofas Gutierrez?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 32, hint-samples.csv row 935, flag adds_marriage, confidence 3). Resolved OUTCOME 2 (the answer is something else). Identity is a true match to tree person Victoriana Vasquez (GFG9-7H4), but the 9 Jan 1875 record (hint ark:/61903/1:1:JC8N-Y3P, Mexico Marriages 1570-1950; parish counterpart ark:/61903/1:1:684J-DSBM, bride persona 684J-DSBS, Jalisco Catholic Church Records) is a VELACION (nuptial blessing), NOT the marriage. image_basis true: reading the register image (ark:/61903/3:1:9392-VB9H-51) establishes the event is a velacion and that the couple 'fueron casados han dieziseis anos, en la Huerta de San Juan, feligresia de San Pedro Piedragorda' -- i.e. married ~1859 there (approximate, DERIVED from the 'sixteen years' statement; exact date unknown and the original marriage register was NOT located). The image reading is licensed under Step 1a: two other indexed entries on the same image match on couple/parents/date -- Asencio x de Leon (ark:/61903/1:1:684J-LXF8, 12 Jan 1875) and Timoteo Rico x Virginia Garcia (ark:/61903/1:1:684J-8WXW / ark:/61903/1:1:XQFP-JG15, 8 Jan 1875). Identity is carried by the 1879 Degollado civil death registration (ark:/61903/1:1:QGWN-N5CM) naming Victoriana as wife of Cleofas Gutierrez and daughter of Remigio Vazquez + Maria Bernarda Sandoval; the marriage is corroborated by the couple's children -- Gregoria's 1879 death (ark:/61903/1:1:QGWJ-3HQ9; burials ark:/61903/1:1:684X-KYNG, ark:/61903/1:1:684J-1Y17) and Silveria's 1900 marriages (ark:/61903/1:1:QG71-GYY1, ark:/61903/1:1:QGQT-KZY4, ark:/61903/1:1:XQZ8-RJT9). No baptism was located for either daughter. Second opinion: pending senior-genealogist review (not yet obtained; no approver named).
